Swadhin Bangla Betar Artist Nasreen
2014-11-20T00:00:50+06:00 | Zaid Kalam
https://www.thedailystar.net/swadhin-bangla-betar-artist-nasreen-54485

With such ordinary equipment they made so many extraordinary programmes, wonders Nasreen Ahamad, an English news caster and singer of Swadhin Bangla Betar Kendra. Nasreen, now the Pro-Vice Chancellor of University of Dhaka, was told whether she can work as news presenter at the Swadhin Bangla Betar Kendra in Baliganj of #Kolkata, India early June of #LiberationWar1971. There on the very day of her arrival she was auditioned very shortly by illustrious filmmaker Alamgir Kabir (1938- 1989), got selected and later recorded her first news casting for the radio station which was broadcasted in the evening.
